tags.name: wire
tags.description: Wire.js reactive element. Its own content is a template: `{{ expr }}` writes an escaped result, `{{{ expr }}}` writes unescaped markup. Re-renders only for the signals named in `to`, `for`, `if` and `with`. Always close it, `<wire />` is not valid HTML.

attributes.name: to
attributes.description: Write a signal's value into the element as escaped text. Takes a signal (`@name`) only. Cannot be used if the element has content; mutually exclusive with `for`.

attributes.name: with
attributes.description: Re-render the element's template whenever any of these signals changes. One or more signals separated by spaces (`@a @b`). List every signal the template reads, or it goes stale.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: Render the element's content once per item of an array. Takes a signal (`@name`) or an expression (`@{ expr }`). Mutually exclusive with `to`. Loop variables are in scope for nested elements.

attributes.name: each
attributes.description: Name of the variable that holds the current item inside a `for`. Literal only; requires `for`.

attributes.name: if
attributes.description: Only render while truthy, otherwise the element is emptied and hidden. Takes a signal (`@name`) or an expression (`@{ expr }`). An expression only re-evaluates for the signals named in the element's attributes.

attributes.name: else
attributes.description: Render when the directly preceding `<wire>` sibling's `if` (or `else`) was false. May carry its own `if` to chain (`else if`). Flag attribute.

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: Inline style. A plain attribute, never parsed as Wire syntax.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: CSS classes. A plain attribute, never parsed as Wire syntax.

tags.name: component
tags.description: Wire.js component. Without `instance` it defines a template (declared args via `arg:name`); with `instance` it renders that template. A component template sees only its own args and globals. Always close it.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Component name. Required. Used to register a template, or to select which template an instance renders. Names are global and unique.

attributes.name: instance
attributes.description: Marks this element as an instance of the named component instead of a template definition. Flag attribute.

attributes.name: arg:
attributes.description: Component argument, written `arg:<name>`. On a template definition it is a bare flag declaring an argument (e.g. `arg:title`); on an instance it takes a literal, a signal (`@name`, reactive) or an expression (`@{ expr }`, typed, evaluated when the instance renders). Arguments left out are `null`. Use `{{ name }}` inside the template to read it.

attributes.name: style
attributes.description: Inline style. A plain attribute, never parsed as Wire syntax.

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: CSS classes. A plain attribute, never parsed as Wire syntax.
